name: web-yoga-sunset-hero-with-feature-list-overlay
title: Sunset Yoga Hero with Feature List
whatItIs: A rounded hero panel with a dimmed sunset photo of a person in a lunge on a beach, a white headline 'Simplifying Your Everyday Health Journey' and a scattered list of features (Health Score, Analytics, AI Assistant, Wellness Tracking, Insights, Progress, Alerts) with plus signs.
whatItMeans: A calm sunset and a scatter of light labels feel serene, and the person's pose echoes the promise of ease.
techniques: Darkened photo to keep white type legible
Feature words scattered in a loose grid with plus icons
Silhouetted body forming part of the composition

vocabulary.definition: Labels spread in an irregular layout rather than a column.
A photo darkened so text on top reads clearly.
A dark body shape used as a composition element.
